samples.text_head: Quarterly Net Asset Value Update | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Quarterly Net Asset Value Update AI Summary Close X Macau Property Opportunities Fund reported an unaudited Adjusted NAV of US$14.2 million (US$0.23/17p per share) as at 30 September 2026, a 25.1% decline (25.0% in GBP) quarter-on-quarter. Seven Waterside units were sold for gross HK$106.7 million (~US$13.7 million) and associated bank debt repaid, but those sales will not be reflected in future NAV; three Fountainside units remain unsold pending consents. The NAV fall reflects Waterside realisations at discounts and further valuation reductions, principally at Penha Heights where one debt facility remains in default, and the company warns expedited disposals could realise materially lower values.
